display_long_description:
Climb or Die pulls you into a brutal vertical world where every level feels alive, watching, and waiting for you to slip. You’re not just climbing walls—you’re navigating a shifting labyrinth built to break you. Each stage blends platforming, horror, and fast‑paced VR movement into one relentless ascent.

Start in the lower tunnels, where dripping pipes echo your footsteps and shadows move even when you don’t. Higher up, the architecture twists into impossible shapes: rotating platforms, collapsing beams, swinging hazards, and narrow ledges that force you to breathe slow and climb smarter. Monsters stalk the routes between levels, learning your patterns, waiting for the moment your grip weakens.

Every new zone introduces fresh mechanics and environmental threats. Flooded chambers force you to climb before the water rises. Wind tunnels shove you off course. Bio‑mechanical growths pulse along the walls, reacting to your movement. Some levels reward precision; others demand speed; all of them punish hesitation.

The tower doesn’t care how skilled you are—it adapts. It remembers. And the higher you climb, the more it tries to kill you. Your only goal is simple: keep moving, keep climbing, and don’t look down. Because in this world, one mistake isn’t just a fall… it’s the end.
